mechanism: Bind two simple graphic characters to two continuously visible physical supports. Change only one measurable support parameter at a time so the pair first demonstrates a shared response, then an asymmetric independent response, then a third materially different relation test. The order, axis and controller may change across instances; character identity and support ownership must remain readable until both supports stabilize into a legible paired state.

invariants.rule: Establish two distinct graphic characters, each visibly bound to one stable physical support.
invariants.ablation_failure: Floating characters with no support cannot make gesture causality readable.

invariants.rule: Change one measurable support parameter and make both characters answer through a readable shared response.
invariants.purpose: Defines the first causal response rule without prescribing compression or an axis.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing body shape without a matching support change feels arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Change a different parameter asymmetrically so one character responds while both bindings remain intact.
invariants.purpose: Proves independent control inside the duet.
invariants.ablation_failure: Applying identical changes to both sides never demonstrates separate ownership.

invariants.rule: Apply a third materially different support relation or controller path without repeating the prior response.
invariants.purpose: Shows a reusable control grammar rather than one canned deformation sequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating the same axis and order makes the middle a surface routine.

invariants.rule: Synchronize both supports and finish with two legible characters still attached to their original sides.
invariants.purpose: Restores the relationship after extreme deformation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing a face, swapping sides or ending as abstract ribbons breaks identity closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source dark-haired woman in a white sweater and beige trousers
the source cream goose-like cartoon blobs with tiny eyes and orange beaks
the source apartment interior and fixed vertical framing
the source exact palm choreography and extreme long-neck ending

instantiations.concept: In an original magnetic observatory, two motorized gimbal bases carry distinct luminous seed-pod characters. Opposite base rotations twist the pods independently, both bases then orbit one central marker while the tethers remain separate, one base tilts to create a single oblique sail response, and the bases finally dock side by side so both pods settle into compact readable forms.

instantiations.concept: On a circular felt loom, two autonomous shuttle discs carry stitched cloud characters. A shared phase pulse makes both clouds ripple, one shuttle alone takes a zigzag rail and turns its cloud into a folded fan, the discs exchange inner and outer circular lanes without crossing ownership, and two latch stations stop them as a balanced paired emblem.
